requests.title: Leave and advance requests
requests.subtitle: Sent by staff from the staff app · nobody approves their own request
requests.emptyBody: Requests appear here once staff sign in to the staff app and ask for leave or an advance.
requests.own: Your own request — another person must decide it
requests.noRight: The HR approve right is needed to decide requests. Ask Admin.
requests.whoBody: A person with the HR approve right decides, and never their own request. The server checks this on every decision; hiding a button is never the check.
requests.afterBody: Leave → marked in attendance for those days and used in that month's payroll. Advance → the cashier pays it on Cash given to staff (cash book entry), and payroll recovers it. Staff hear back in the app and on WhatsApp (no amounts in the message).
requests.approveLeaveEffect: The leave days are marked in attendance and the person is told.
requests.approveAdvanceEffect: The advance can then be paid on Cash given to staff, and payroll recovers it.
requests.rejectEffect: The person is told the request was rejected.
